start.text: *The busker strums a holographic laser-harp guitar, producing haunting synthesized melodies that echo down the neon corridor.* "Halt, wandering operative. Will you spare a thought—or a credit—for the Ballad of the City?"

choices.text: "Play me a song about Mack and his War-Rig. [Tip 20 Credits]"
"Sing of Duncan and the Towers of Dunsinane."
"What do you sing when the night turns cold?"

start_night.text: *The strings of light shimmer deep violet in the evening fog.* "Ah, the night travelers emerge... when the streetlights flicker and the ghosts of old Glasgow hum in the wires. What shall I play for your soul, Banquo?"

choices.text: "Sing of the Three Sisters in the mist. [Tip 20 Credits]"
"Play something to steel my nerve for the road."

start_post_battle.text: *The bard strikes a triumphant golden chord.* "I felt the highway quake! The iron beast roared, and corporate steel turned to ash! The muse inspires a new epic!"

song_mack.text:
*The harp resonates with heavy industrial bass rhythm.*

'Upon the asphalt, iron-crowned,
Where thunder shakes the toxic ground,
Great Mack advances through the haze,
And sets the corporate road ablaze!'

song_duncan.text:
*A somber, echoing melody drifts through the air.*

'High above the smog and rain,
King Duncan counts his gilded gain,
Yet stone and glass shall surely fall,
When Birnam marches to the wall...'

song_witches.text:
*Whispering synthesizer tones mimic wind howling through cables.*

'Fair is foul, and foul is fair,
Hover through the neon air,
Three phantoms weave the fateful thread,
Before the morning stars have fled...'

song_tragedy.text:
*Soft melancholic arpeggios chime.*

'Life's but a walking shadow on the screen,
A poor netrunner that struts and frets his hour,
And then is heard no more.'

choices.text: "A tale told by an idiot, full of sound and fury..."

song_victory.text:
*A glorious crescendo fills the alley, neon light cascading like sparks.*

'Cry havoc on the highway line!
The War-Rig shatters their design!
No corporate armor shall withstand
The fury of this rebel band!'
